module.description: Canonical module path for this package.

name.description: Package name used as the tool namespace prefix.

useWhenHint.description: Optional short guidance for when to use this package. Leave empty for obvious well-known services already likely to be in model training data. Omit the "use {tool name } when" but ensure  the hint follows the structure. E.g. [use skipup when ]scheduling meetings with multiple participants

runtime.description: Execution runtime for the tool's TypeScript code.

additionalTypeScriptGlobs.description: Extra glob patterns for TypeScript files to include beyond tool entries.

executables.description: Map of binary name to WASM file path for WASM-based tools.

credentials.description: Credential declarations for OAuth2, API key, or bearer token injection.

header_name.description: Custom header name for api_key_header method. Defaults to X-API-Key.

allowed_hosts.description: Hosts that tools in this package are allowed to contact.

tools.description: Tool definitions. Each tool has an entry TypeScript file.

entry_ts.description: Path to the tool's TypeScript entry file, relative to the package root.

effect.description: Data access level. readOnly: no side effects (e.g. list, get, search). reversible: creates data that can be undone (e.g. create draft, add tag). irreversible: may edit or delete data, or cause irreversible side effects (e.g. send message, update record, delete).

idempotent.description: Whether calling this tool multiple times with the same input produces the same result.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the tool does.

paramsSchema.description: JSON Schema for the tool's input parameters.
